row.answer: Yuumi is a support mage who attaches to allies and casts from their position while untargetable to most threats. She supports her host with healing and shields, while dealing magic damage with AP scaling.

row.answer: You and Me! lets Yuumi dash to an allied champion and attach, switch hosts, or detach. While attached, she casts from her host's position and is untargetable except to turrets and inbound projectiles. Immobilizing, grounding, or polymorphing her puts this ability on cooldown. While attached to her Best Friend, Yuumi gains heal and shield power and that ally gains on-hit healing.
row.counterplay: Pressure her host while she is attached; use crowd control when she is exposed to delay reattachment.

row.answer: Final Chapter channels waves that deal magic damage and slow enemies, with repeated hits strengthening the slow. The waves heal allied champions, convert excess healing into a shield, and heal her Best Friend more. When cast while attached, Yuumi can steer the waves, but detaching removes that steering for the remaining channel. She can move while detached and can use You and Me! and Zoomies during the channel.
row.counterplay: Move out of the wave path early and avoid chasing through repeated waves into her protected allies.
